offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures microturbine generators that produce on-site electricity and heat for commercial and industrial customers. Sells through a distributor network and provides rental fleets, parts and long-term service contracts for installed units.

primary_products.value: microturbine generators; combined heat and power systems; replacement parts and remanufactured microturbine components

primary_services.value: equipment servicing and maintenance contracts; microturbine rentals; installation and commissioning support

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas operators, commercial buildings, industrial facilities, and distributors

end_markets.value: oil and gas; commercial buildings; industrial manufacturing; renewable energy; microgrids and data centers

revenue_model.value: product sales: microturbine units and parts sold to distributors and end users; service fees: long-term factory protection plans and maintenance and repair; rental or leasing: microturbines rented to customers
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds microturbines from purchased components, sold to distributors and end users; service provider: services and maintains installed microturbine fleets for owners

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia, Middle East, and Latin America via distributors

specialization.value: related lines: microturbine units, parts, services and rentals

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: authorized global distributors who sell and service microturbines; direct sales: service contracts, parts and rentals to end users

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: emissions and air quality rules, safety standards and grid interconnection requirements
